capabilities: hide app ribbon, tab bar, and status bar with optional hotkeys
hide vault name, scrollbars, and tooltips
hide search suggestions and search match counts
hide metadata in Reading view and instructions in prompts
inject body classes for theme compatibility
disambiguation: Not a theme; it only toggles visibility of specific UI elements via CSS classes.
extras: Notes that a CSS theme may override Hider's behavior and documents the body classes it injects so theme authors can stay compatible.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide individual interface chrome like the ribbon, status bar, or tooltips for a cleaner workspace.
summary: UI-toggling plugin that hides Obsidian interface elements such as the ribbon, tab bar, status bar, tooltips, and scrollbars.
